description: Edit CSV/TSV files as a table. Only the cells you change are rewritten.
config.language.description: Language of the table view. Auto follows the VS Code display language: Korean if it is Korean, otherwise English. Command and menu names always follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (English if it is not Korean)
config.headerMode.description: Which header the table view fixes in place. The table view toggle changes this setting, so every CSV file uses the same choice.
config.headerMode.row: First row is the header (fixed at the top)
config.headerMode.column: First column is the header (fixed at the left)
